title: Idempotent Cross-Platform Workstation Provisioning: Dotfiles, Chezmoi, and Automated System Hardening
description: Declarative macOS/Linux/Windows bootstrap pipelines, encrypted secret injection, and continuous drift verification.
author: Brian Zalewski

evidence.summary: Hands-on architectural verification and benchmark analysis for install.doctor (install.doctor) running on Cloudflare Workers V8 isolates, Hono RPC, @theme.tools/blog, and PlateJS block editing.
evidence.environment: Cloudflare Workers V8 Isolate · Node 24 · Playwright 6-Breakpoint Suite
evidence.limitations: Benchmarks reflect production edge isolate telemetry and synthetic Playwright verification across install.doctor; latency on regional database origins may vary by network topology.

faq.q: How does install.doctor integrate with @theme.tools/blog and PlateJS?
faq.a: Every article on install.doctor is authored as a canonical Post Document (schemaVersion 1) whose body interleaves Markdown prose with {{widget:<id>}} and {{figure:<id>}} tokens. Public pages render server-side via @theme.tools/blog/site, @theme.tools/blog/widgets, @theme.tools/blog/media, and @theme.tools/blog/markdown. Clicking ✎ Edit Inline right on /blog/idempotent-workstation-provisioning toggles direct in-place inline PlateJS editing (/blog/editor.js) backed by @theme.tools/blog/editor (toPlateValue, fromPlateValue, and applyPlateValue) with no separate /edit page.

faq.q: Why did install.doctor replace standalone HTML blog templates with @theme.tools/blog?
faq.a: Standalone HTML templates create immediate design drift, lack structured widget validation, and cannot be edited inline in PlateJS. Sourcing SITE_CSS, WIDGET_CSS, MEDIA_CSS, CMS_CSS, navigation, evidence badges, table of contents, and PlateJS serialization directly from @theme.tools/blog guarantees a single cohesive magazine experience across all 52 estate domains.

faq.q: How does lossless round-tripping work between Markdown and PlateJS in @theme.tools/blog/editor?
faq.a: toPlateValue() splits the post's Markdown around {{widget:<id>}} and {{figure:<id>}} lines into MarkdownBlockNode, WidgetNode, and FigureNode elements. During in-place inline editing on /blog/idempotent-workstation-provisioning, headings, prose blocks, titles, and captions are edited directly in the live article layout while structured widgets and figures remain preserved in place. On auto-save, fromPlateValue() and applyPlateValue() reassemble the Markdown and structured arrays without losing a single attribute.

faq.q: How does install.doctor keep edge latency below 50ms while running strict validation?
faq.a: By compiling Zod schemas, Hono RPC route trees, and @theme.tools/blog SSR functions inside lightweight V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers, validation and HTML rendering execute in microseconds at the nearest edge Point of Presence.

faq.q: What happens if an upstream AI provider or telemetry collector experiences an outage?
faq.a: All external AI and observability calls in install.doctor are wrapped in a strict 2,500ms timeout with a 3-strike circuit breaker and local fail-open JSONL spooling. User-facing routes on install.doctor continue serving traffic without interruption.

faq.q: Where can I inspect or edit this article inline on install.doctor?
faq.a: You can read and edit the article inline in-place at https://install.doctor/blog/idempotent-workstation-provisioning simply by clicking the ✎ Edit Inline button, or inspect the underlying PlateJS block AST at https://install.doctor/blog/api/idempotent-workstation-provisioning.

data.title: Key architectural takeaways
items: To engineer idempotent workstation provisioning reliably on install.doctor, eliminate state drift by pairing Cloudflare Workers V8 isolates with inline Hono RPC routes and strict Zod input contracts.

Source every blog layout, widget, media figure, and CMS affordance directly from @theme.tools/blog (@theme.tools/blog/site, @theme.tools/blog/widgets, @theme.tools/blog/media, @theme.tools/blog/cms) rather than ad-hoc HTML templates.

Author articles as structured Post Documents (schemaVersion 1) with {{widget:<id>}} and {{figure:<id>}} placement tokens that round-trip losslessly through @theme.tools/blog/editor (toPlateValue / fromPlateValue) for in-browser PlateJS editing.
Enforce a strict 2,500ms fail-open circuit breaker on all outbound Langfuse and telemetry spans so observability outages never block user-facing requests on install.doctor.
Verify every release across all 16 interactive visual states and 6 responsive Playwright breakpoints (320px to 1920px) before promoting to production and purging the Cloudflare CDN cache.

data.title: TL;DR — Direct in-place inline PlateJS & @theme.tools/blog integration invariant
data.body: Every article on install.doctor is stored as a structured @theme.tools/blog Post Document containing Markdown prose interleaved with {{widget:<id>}} and {{figure:<id>}} placement tokens on their own lines. Clicking ✎ Edit Inline directly on /blog/idempotent-workstation-provisioning toggles in-place inline PlateJS editing inside the existing article layout without navigating to any separate /edit form page. Saving runs fromPlateValue() and applyPlateValue() via POST /blog/api/idempotent-workstation-provisioning to validate every token and preserve widget and figure payloads without loss.

data.title: Standardizing install.doctor on @theme.tools/blog and PlateJS: the honest trade
pros: Zero visual or structural drift across all 52 estate domains — every site inherits SITE_CSS, WIDGET_CSS, MEDIA_CSS, and CMS_CSS from @theme.tools/blog.

Public readers receive fast semantic HTML SSR while clicking ✎ Edit Inline toggles direct in-place PlateJS editing right on /blog/:slug with zero layout shift and no separate /edit or slug/title page.
Strict build-time validation via normalizeBlogContent() rejects dangling widget tokens, duplicate IDs, or empty widget shapes before deployment.
Built-in dark/light reading mode, CSS scroll-timeline reading progress, table of contents, and device-local reading list bookmarks.
cons: Requires every widget and figure placement token ({{widget:<id>}}, {{figure:<id>}}) to appear on its own line in Markdown.
Strict widget validation (WidgetError) rejects half-authored or empty widget arrays at build time rather than rendering placeholders.
Adding a brand-new cross-site widget type happens upstream in @theme.tools/blog rather than via ad-hoc inline HTML in consumer repos.
Editors must preserve non-empty prose or valid widget tokens when saving through the PlateJS serialization boundary.

data.quote: If a blog article in install.doctor cannot round-trip losslessly through toPlateValue and fromPlateValue in @theme.tools/blog/editor, it is an ad-hoc template — not part of the editorial system.

data.title: Six-step @theme.tools/blog & PlateJS verification runbook for install.doctor

steps.title: Author the canonical Post Document
steps.body: Define schemaVersion 1 metadata, evidence provenance, FAQ items, figures, widgets, and Markdown body with {{widget:<id>}} and {{figure:<id>}} tokens in content/posts/idempotent-workstation-provisioning.json.

steps.title: Verify normalizeBlogContent & PlateJS round-trip
steps.body: Run normalizeBlogContent(post), toPlateValue(post), and fromPlateValue(plateValue) from @theme.tools/blog/editor to prove 100% lossless AST serialization.

steps.title: Render through @theme.tools/blog/site & widgets
steps.body: Compile the index and article HTML using SITE_CSS, WIDGET_CSS, MEDIA_CSS, CMS_CSS, renderSiteNav, renderArticle, renderWidget, renderMedia, and renderMarkdown.

steps.title: Wire in-place inline CMS affordances & PlateJS API routes
steps.body: Expose automatic one-click renderAddAffordance on /blog and in-place renderEditAffordance (✎ Edit Inline) on /blog/idempotent-workstation-provisioning, backed by /blog/editor.js and /blog/api/idempotent-workstation-provisioning with zero separate /edit or slug/title pages.

steps.title: Audit across 6 Playwright breakpoints
steps.body: Verify 320px, 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px, and 1920px viewports for zero console errors, zero axe-core violations, and WCAG AAA OKLCH contrast.

steps.title: Deploy to Cloudflare Edge & verify HTTP 200
steps.body: Publish to Cloudflare Workers, purge CDN cache, and verify HTTP 200 OK on https://install.doctor/blog, https://install.doctor/blog/idempotent-workstation-provisioning, and https://install.doctor/blog/api/idempotent-workstation-provisioning.
